title: SMOK X-PRIV Solo 80W Starter Kit
description:
The
SMOK X-PRIV Solo 80W Starter Kit
includes the X-PRIV Solo mod paired with the TF-D Subtank for a complete DTL vaping setup. Features a dual touchscreen display, adjustable top airflow, and leak-proof tank design.
Product Type:
Box Mod Starter Kit
Kit Contents:
1× X-PRIV Solo 80W Mod, 1× TF-D Subtank (3.5mL), 1× 0.15Ω D-Coil (pre-installed), 1× 0.23Ω D-Coil, 1× Bulb Glass (5.5mL), 1× USB-C Cable
Wattage Range:
5-80W
Battery:
Single 18650 (sold separately)
Charging:
USB Type-C (2.5A Fast Charging)
Tank Capacity:
3.5mL (standard) / 5.5mL (bulb glass)
Coil Resistance:
SMOK D-Coils (0.15Ω, 0.23Ω, 0.4Ω available)
Airflow:
Adjustable Top Airflow
Display:
Dual Touchscreen
Brand:
SMOK
Battery and e-liquid sold separately. Suitable for freebase e-liquids. Replacement D-Coils sold separately.
This product contains nicotine. Nicotine is a highly addictive substance.
Available options: Black Shell, Silver Lines.
